listing.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Forbidden Memories — FM-Recomp (TechX1320)
listing.summary: Upstream reports a complete NPC duel in v0.1.10. Startup uses its documented APv2 bypass, and missing dispatch entries stop execution. SPU unit tests do not establish working audio throughout gameplay. Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay. Follow the setup instructions below. Portcove has not confirmed setup or gameplay.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own exact USA SLUS-01411 disc and CUE, plus your own SCPH1001 BIOS. Compare both with the full hashes in the upstream README.

steps.title: Follow upstream setup
steps.instruction: Follow the MSYS2 instructions to check, extract and regenerate code from your own inputs, then build ForbiddenMemories.exe locally. Upstream documents RUN_FM_APV2_BYPASS.cmd for startup. Portcove does not install or prepare this source project automatically.

warnings: Upstream reports a complete NPC duel in v0.1.10. Startup uses its documented APv2 bypass, and missing dispatch entries stop execution. SPU unit tests do not establish working audio throughout gameplay. Portcove has not confirmed runtime behavior or gameplay.
